title: Microducks
subtitle: 12 ducks in the schoolyard
examples: Tap a duck number to ride its head camera
about: Simulation: 12 Microducks in one shared NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.2 + Newton world, rendered live with Omniverse RTX (OVRTX). All 12 run the same ONNX walking and recovery policy at 50 Hz (trained in Isaac Lab with BAM actuator models). Velocity commands come from the buttons or from typed orders: an LLM agent (NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt) picks a tool and the navigator plans the paths. The policy does the walking and the getting up.

examples: Tap a duck number to ride its head camera
about: Live version of the keynote demo: 12 Microducks in NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.2 + Newton on the Holodeck set, rendered live with Omniverse RTX (OVRTX). The navigator never reads the simulator: 4 fixed RGB-D cameras (Isaac Lab cameras, Newton Warp renderer) mapped the yard in the first 1.5 s and track every duck from depth and segmentation at 10 Hz. Typed orders go to NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, which can read the perceived state or look through a camera, then picks one tool; after each order the cameras check the result and Nemotron reports it below. All 12 ducks run the same ONNX walking policy at 50 Hz. Runs at about 0.8x real time.
